_comment: Shape of the 'fleet' field at op://homelab/topology/fleet.
This file is an EXAMPLE. The real one lives in 1Password because it holds
the sensitive half of the topology: which hypervisors exist, how to reach
them, and the credentials for them. For an MSP that is reconnaissance
material and does not belong in a repository.
The structural half - octet and control plane count - lives in git at
config/sites.json, where it can be reviewed and tested. Keys here must
match keys there; a mismatch fails at plan time.
Adding a hypervisor is appending to a site's nodes array. Nothing else
